# On-call Runbook

## Escalation
1. Check #incidents
2. Page primary on-call via PagerDuty
3. If unresolved in 15m, escalate to secondary

## Common Issues
- DB connection pool exhaustion: restart api pods
- 5xx spike: check Sentry issue WEB-3F2
